claims.claim_text: Section 311.4 prohibits using a vent pipe as a soil or waste pipe, or a soil/waste pipe as a vent, except as provided in Sections 812, 813, and 814; it also prohibits single drainage and venting systems with unvented branch lines.
claims.notes: OCR/text-extraction issue resolved for calibration; manual licensed-human SME still required before publication.

claims.claim_text: A loop or circuit vent connects downstream of the last fixture connection on a horizontal soil or waste branch.
